description: Deterministic acceptance policy shared by article flow, column reflow, and bounded repair transactions. The comparator first enforces non-worsening invariants, then requires one strict improvement. Total and per-kind finding counts may not increase, every surviving issue must retain or reduce every declared severity dimension, and a newly introduced issue at or above reject_new_at_or_above is always rejected. A transaction is accepted only when a count falls or a surviving severity vector strictly improves.
